camel_example: aliyun avatar DuplexDecision --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId 1 --AppId 12131231 --Text '你好' --CallTime 1 --DialogStatus ROBOT_TALK --SessionId xxxxxxxxxx --BizRequestId xxxxxxxxxx --version 2022-01-30 --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun avatar duplex-decision --tenant-id 1 --app-id 12131231 --session-id xxxxxxxxxx --biz-request-id xxxxxxxxxx --dialog-status ROBOT_TALK --call-time 1 --text '你好' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DuplexDecision

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can obtain the tenant ID from the Virtual Digital Human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The app ID. You can view the app ID in the developer information section in the lower-right corner of the business configuration details page
parameters.help_zh: App ID。在业务配置详情页的右下角可以看到开发者信息AppId
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the conversation session
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The business request ID. This is a unique ID for each request
parameters.help_zh: 业务请求id，每次请求的唯一id
parameters.name: biz_request_id

parameters.help_en:
The current call status. Valid values:

ROBOT_TALK: The digital human is broadcasting and can be interrupted by the user. Pass this value whenever the digital human is broadcasting.
USER_TALK: The digital human is not broadcasting and the user is speaking, and the robot can take over the conversation
parameters.help_zh:
当前通话状态 ；

“ROBOT_TALK”：即数字人在播报，用户可打断。数字人只要在播报时就传该状态
“USER_TALK”：即数字人未播报并且用户在说话，机器人可承接
parameters.name: dialog_status

parameters.help_en:
The call timing. Valid values:

0: Mid-sentence.
1: End of sentence
parameters.help_zh:
调用时机:

0： 句中
1： 句尾
parameters.name: call_time

parameters.help_en: The text content of the user's speech recognized by automatic speech recognition (ASR)
parameters.help_zh: ASR识别的用户说的话对应的文本内容
parameters.name: text

fields.help_en: The response from the digital human
fields.help_zh: 数字人回复的问答结果
fields.name: robot

fields.help_en: The text spoken by the user
fields.name: user

fields.help_en: The conversation history. You can retrieve up to the last 20 conversation turns
fields.help_zh: 对话历史（可以取最近的20轮对话）
fields.name: histories

parameters.help_en:
The interrupt type. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 0. Valid values:

0: Algorithm-based semantic interrupt.
1: Custom interrupt word.
2: Custom interrupt word and algorithm-based semantic interrupt
parameters.help_zh:
打断类型：不传默认为0

0：算法语义打断类型
1：自定义打断词
2：自定义打断词+算法语义打断
parameters.name: interrupt_type

parameters.help_en: The list of custom interrupt words. The list can contain up to 100 words, and each word can contain up to 10 characters. This parameter is required when InterruptType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 自定义的打断词列表，词的数目不超过100，每个词的字数不超过10个字，InterruptType为1时，该字段必填
parameters.name: custom_keywords

ActionType.description_en:
The action type determined by the algorithm. Valid values:
INTERRUPT: Interrupt.
NO_ACTION: No action.
UNDERTAKE: Take over
ActionType.description_zh:
算法决策出的行为类别，可选项如下：
 INTERRUPT：打断
 NO_ACTION：没有动作行为
 UNDERTAKE：承接

GrabType.description_en:
Specifies whether the current ASR text needs to trigger a question-and-answer request after the broadcast of the digital human is interrupted. Valid values:
GRAB: Triggers a question-and-answer request.
NO_GRAB: Does not trigger a question-and-answer request
GrabType.description_zh:
打断数字人播报后，当前的ASR文本是否需要去请求问答
GRAB：触发问答
NO_GRAB：不触发问答

OutputText.description_en: The output text used to take over the conversation

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful
